dialogue.chat: You again. Fine, talk. The turnips were boring me anyway. Don't tell them.
dialogue.chat/1: Talk, then. I was only going to complain at a fence otherwise.
dialogue.chat/2: Make it quick or make it interesting. Preferably both, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: Talking, is it. Fine. Make it worth the interruption.
dialogue.conversations/1: You've got my ear. Briefly. It's attached to work.
dialogue.conversations/2: Go on. But if this is about the fence, I've already heard it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Good, and don't spread it around. People start expecting cheerful.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Fine. Suspiciously fine. I'm waiting for the catch.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Well enough. Ask again tomorrow and ruin it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Bad stretch. The roof, my back, everything. ...You're the first who asked, %1$s. Don't gloat.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Rough. Don't fuss over it. ...But don't stop asking, either.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You asked me that already, %1$s. The answer aged like milk, not wine.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice now. My mood doesn't improve on a schedule for anyone.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Nothing broke and nobody borrowed anything. A shameful shortage of things to complain about.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Tolerable. I'll find something wrong with it by supper, give me time.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The well rope snapped, the bread came out brick, and now questions. In that order.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Everything that could go sideways did. You're the sideways I minded least, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: It's mine and I do it right, which is more than most manage. Call that liking it if you must.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I don't like it. I respect it. There's a difference and you're standing in it.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: I hate it Tuesdays through Sundays. Mondays I'm too tired to hate anything properly.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: It pays for the roof I complain about. Round and round we go.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? Full of borrowed tools and loud opinions. Wouldn't leave it, mind. Don't quote me on that.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: Lived in %2$s my whole life. Long enough to know exactly whose fence sags and why.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: The neighbors. Hm. Half owe me apologies, the other half owe me tools. I keep both lists.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Decent enough, if you like noise and unreturned ladders. I've made peace with the ladders. Mostly.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever I didn't have to cook and nobody's watching me eat. Preferably in silence.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: The baker's rye. Don't tell the baker — he's insufferable enough as it is.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: You want the whole slog? Nobody's ever asked. Fine. Sit. Interrupt once and the story stops.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: Long, grey, and mine. There's a good bit in the middle. Don't rush me to it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A gate that doesn't squeak and neighbors who knock less. And the sea, once. Forget the sea part.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: Peace and a working hinge. I dream small so I'm rarely disappointed. Rarely.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That grouch is all they'll carve on the stone. There's more than that in here. ...Laugh and I'll deny this.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Being nothing but the complaining. ...You didn't hear that. The wind said it.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You're a nuisance, %1$s. The kind I catch myself checking the road for. Don't make it a thing.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You grow on a person. Like moss. I've decided not to scrape you off.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: I don't unpack that for folk I've known five minutes. Keep showing up and we'll see, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That drawer's stuck shut for strangers. Come back when you're not one.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: That answer's earned, not asked for. You're closer than most. Don't let it go to your head.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: No. Not yet. 'Yet' is generous, and I'm not a generous man, so treasure it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing's happened. Blessed silence. Don't go starting something just to have news.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Quiet week. Finally. Don't you dare jinx it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? With you, aye. Don't look so pleased. ...Fine, look a little pleased.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: You married a grumbler and stayed. That's the happiness, right there. Don't gloat.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: %2$s and %3$s went and got married. More noise, more cake I didn't ask for. ...Fine. They looked happy. Don't tell them I noticed.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: Heard %2$s wed %3$s. Whole village singing at all hours. ...Good match, though. Not that anyone asked my blessing.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: %2$s and %3$s split. Saw it coming a mile off. Shame, mind — don't wish that on anyone. Now stop looking at me like that.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: %2$s and %3$s parted ways. Messy business. I'll keep my opinions to myself for once, %1$s. Both of 'em could use the quiet.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s is gone, %1$s. ...Aye. Hard news, that. Good soul, whatever I grumbled otherwise. The village is smaller without them.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We lost %2$s. Don't have the words, and I'm not one for words anyway. ...Just a sad thing. A genuinely sad thing.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s had a baby. More crying at all hours, mark my words. ...Little thing's got good lungs, though. Suppose that's something.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: New baby over at %2$s's. Whole village cooing like fools. ...Held it for a minute. Didn't hate it. That stays between us.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: %2$s moved in. Another neighbor to borrow my tools and never return them. ...I'll give 'em a week before I judge. Maybe two.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: Some newcomer — %2$s — settled in. Great. More opinions I didn't ask for. ...Seem alright, I suppose. Reserving judgment.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s upped and left for good. Won't be the same without 'em to argue with. ...Not that I'll say so out loud. You didn't hear it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: %2$s moved away, %1$s. Packed up the whole life and went. ...Odd, how a quiet village can feel too quiet of a sudden.
dialogue.chatmode.confused: Speak plainly or let me work.
dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s. Which. I haven't got all day.
dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Say that again. I dare you.
dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Still alive then, %1$s. Good, I suppose.
